first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making onboarding simplification the most directly relevant intervention. Verify the two prior onboarding/signup results before acting, especially their durability and whether gains translated into qualified revenue rather than only completion. Run a guarded self-serve/SMB test with qualified revenue, activation quality, and retention as guardrails; avoid broad rollout until downstream value is confirmed.

final.rationale: Run a standard guarded experiment shortening onboarding for self-serve SMB accounts, where the verified evidence is directly relevant: completion improved 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and retention rose 3%; signup simplification also lifted activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%, though retention declined 1%. Measure activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue, with retention and qualified-revenue guardrails. This addresses both current onboarding and activation declines without broad rollout or relying on unverified price discounts.
